title: RhoA Y42C drives cell plasticity and PD-1-mediated immune evasion of diffuse gastric cancer.
snippet: Diffuse gastric cancer (DGC) is an aggressive gastric cancer subtype with a poor prognosis. The RHOA Y42C mutation is recurrent in DGC, but its independent oncogenic role is unclear.
